candidates.reason: Uses the materialized route-filtering CTE from parent index 0 and COUNT() aggregation from parent index 3. Both parents use the same predicate, so no complementary predicate component exists.
candidates.sql:
WITH filtered_routes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
)
SELECT pickup, dropoff, COUNT() AS trips
FROM filtered_routes
GROUP BY pickup, dropoff
